question: If Zalto, Fire Giant Duke is dealt lethal damage, do I still get to venture into the dungeon?

expected.shortAnswer: Yes: you still venture into the dungeon.
expected.answer: If Zalto is dealt lethal damage, you will still get to venture into the dungeon.
